prompt: transform this video into code, be the more realistic as you can

rubric.c: The HTML opens in Chrome and the scene renders, with no errors or blank screen
rubric.rc: Technical notes confirm the page loaded and rendered in Chromium with no console or page errors.
rubric.mc: Per the technical notes, the page loaded and rendered cleanly in Chromium with no console or page errors.

rubric.c: The scene runs at 30 fps or more on a standard laptop
rubric.rc: Technical notes state that frame rate was only observed under software rendering and was not measured on a standard laptop GPU; a hardware-accelerated FPS test is needed.
rubric.mc: Per the technical notes, frame rate was only tested under slow software rendering, so a real GPU test on a standard laptop is needed.

rubric.c: The flyover starts playing on load; pause freezes the camera and everything in the scene; play resumes from the same frame
rubric.rc: Technical notes confirm playback starts on load, pause freezes the scene on the current frame, and play resumes from that exact frame.
rubric.mc: Per the technical notes, automated testing confirmed playback starts on load, pauses cleanly, and resumes from the exact paused timestamp.

rubric.c: The result is code: a page that draws the scene live in the browser from a moving viewpoint. It does not play back a video file or a flat sequence of the video's frames
rubric.rc: Technical notes confirm WebGL renders 3D depth-recovered meshes from moving camera positions, synthesizing five out of every six frames live rather than playing a video or flat frame sequence.
rubric.mc: Per the technical notes and parallax in the capture, the scene is rendered live via a procedural WebGL2 ray-marching shader rather than video frames.

rubric.c: Nothing is added that the video does not contain: no text, logos or overlays on the scene, no extra objects (birds, clouds, people, vehicles), and no interaction beyond the playback controls
rubric.rc: No text, logos, overlays, or extra objects appear in the scene across the entire capture.
rubric.mc: Stills 1–3 show bright white water-like patches on the far left that do not exist in the reference video.

rubric.c: Dense green broadleaf forest covers the near hills and fills the lower half of the opening view, as in the video
rubric.rc: Dense broadleaf forest covers the near hills and fills the lower half of the frame at 0:00 and in Still 1.
rubric.mc: In Still 1, large bare brown fields already cut across the middle-right instead of dense broadleaf forest filling the near hills.

rubric.c: Layered mountain ridges span the full width of the background, with the same skyline profile as the video (highest ridge left of centre, lower ridges stepping down to the right)
rubric.rc: Layered background ridges span the full width with the exact skyline profile of the reference throughout the clip.
rubric.mc: Across Stills 1–6, the background skyline lacks the video's distinct left-of-center peak and high far-left slope, showing flatter ridges split by a gap on the left.

rubric.c: A brown tilled field lies in a clearing among the trees and comes to dominate the lower-middle of the view in the second half of the clip
rubric.rc: The brown tilled clearing emerges among the trees and dominates the lower-middle view from 0:10 onward.
rubric.mc: The brown field is already exposed on the right from Still 1 and overtakes almost the entire lower half by Stills 5–6 rather than sitting in a tree-lined clearing.

rubric.c: A greenhouse complex with rows of white or silver tunnel roofs and one long red-roofed building sits at the lower right by the end of the clip
rubric.rc: The greenhouse complex with white/silver tunnel roofs and the red-roofed building sits at the lower right from 0:15 to 0:19.
rubric.mc: In Still 6 and Close-ups 1–2, only crude red, white, and blue blocks peek out behind a tall ridge, missing the rows of tunnel roofs at the lower right.

rubric.c: A pale dirt track and a small dark pond are visible among the trees at the lower right in the first half of the clip
rubric.rc: The pale dirt track and small dark pond are clearly visible at the lower right around 0:04–0:06 and in Still 2.
rubric.mc: In Still 2 and Close-up 4, the lower right shows wide beige striped flats and a broad pale band with no dark pond or narrow forest track.

rubric.c: The valley on the right holds terraced, striped crop plots and scattered small farm buildings, including green-roofed ones
rubric.rc: Terraced striped crop plots and small green-roofed buildings populate the right valley across all stills.
rubric.mc: In Stills 1–6 and Close-up 4, the right valley contains only flat planes and a single large cyan block rather than terraced crop plots and scattered farm buildings.

rubric.c: The sky is clear and cloudless: a bright, almost white haze at the upper left grading to teal blue at the right
rubric.rc: The cloudless sky grades smoothly from bright pale haze at the upper left to teal blue on the right.
rubric.mc: Across all stills, the sky is a washed-out pale grey-white with almost none of the reference's saturated teal-blue gradient on the right.

rubric.c: Colours and time of day match the video: strong daytime sun, warm saturated greens in the foreground, cooler blue-green in the distance
rubric.rc: Daytime sunlight, warm foreground greens, and cooler distant blue-greens match the video across all frames.
rubric.mc: Stills 1–6 look desaturated and hazy with pale yellow-greens, missing the video's rich foreground greens and cool blue-green distance.

rubric.c: Without the prompt, the scene is recognisable as an aerial view over forested hills with farmland in a valley
rubric.rc: The scene immediately reads as an aerial flyover of forested hills and valley farmland.
rubric.mc: Sheer extruded cliff walls and giant corrugated stripes in Stills 3–6 make the scene read as an abstract heightmap rather than natural hills and valley farmland.

rubric.c: The hills have real relief: rounded slopes, folds and valleys with depth, not a flat backdrop or a single plane
rubric.rc: The hills display rounded slopes, valleys, and 3D parallax during the flyover rather than acting as a flat plane.
rubric.mc: While 3D depth is present, midground hills form unnatural vertical walls in Stills 3–6 rather than rounded slopes and folds.

rubric.c: The forest canopy reads as individual tree crowns of varied size and height, not a smooth carpet or uniform blobs
rubric.rc: The canopy resolves into varied individual tree crowns throughout the foreground and middle ground.
rubric.mc: In Stills 1–3 and Close-ups 3–4, the canopy looks like uniform spiky green cones rather than varied broadleaf tree crowns.

rubric.c: Buildings and greenhouses keep their shape: straight edges, evenly spaced parallel roof rows, no bent, broken or merged lines
rubric.rc: In Close-ups 1 and 2, several greenhouse roof lines slightly bend and smear where foreground tree depth meshes overlap them.
rubric.mc: Close-ups 1–2 replace the parallel greenhouse rows with a few plain solid blocks mostly occluded by a steep green wall.

rubric.c: The opening view matches the video's first frame: horizon about a third of the way down, sky above, ridges across the middle, forest below
rubric.rc: Still 1 matches the video's opening composition with the horizon a third down, ridges mid-frame, and forest below.
rubric.mc: Still 1 breaks the opening composition with large exposed brown flats on the right and bright white patches along the left hills.

rubric.c: The horizon stays level for the whole clip
rubric.rc: The horizon remains level from start to finish.
rubric.mc: The horizon remains level across the entire clip from 00:00 to 00:18.

rubric.c: Light comes from the upper left as in the video: the sky is brightest there and tree crowns are lit on that side with shade on the other
rubric.rc: Directional light from the upper left matches the video's bright sky gradient and sunlit tree crowns.
rubric.mc: Stills 1–3 show a brighter upper-left sky and directional shading on the terrain bumps lit from the upper left.

rubric.c: Distant ridges are paler and bluer than the near hills (atmospheric haze)
rubric.rc: Distant mountain ridges appear paler and bluer than the near hills, matching the video's atmospheric haze.
rubric.mc: In Stills 1–6, distant ridges fade toward pale grey-green rather than shifting bluer than the foreground hills.

rubric.c: Exposure looks natural: forest shadows are dark but keep detail, and no large area is crushed to black or blown out to flat white beyond what the video shows
rubric.rc: Exposure stays balanced with preserved shadow detail in the trees and no unnatural clipping.
rubric.mc: Midground valleys in Stills 3–6 are washed out by milky haze instead of retaining dark, detailed forest shadows.

rubric.c: Trees cast shadows where the video shows them, for example along the near edge of the tilled field
rubric.rc: Cast tree shadows along the near edge of the tilled field and dirt track match the reference in Stills 3 and 4.
rubric.mc: Close-up 3 shows smooth height transitions and wide stripe shading with no crisp shadows cast by trees onto the field edge.

rubric.c: Foliage reads as leaves: matte, mottled light and dark greens, not flat colour or plastic
rubric.rc: Tree crowns show matte, mottled light and dark green leaf detail rather than flat or plastic shading.
rubric.mc: In Close-ups 1–4, foliage appears as smooth shaded heightfield cones and stretched green gradients rather than matte mottled leaves.

rubric.c: The tilled field reads as bare furrowed soil, with fine plough lines visible
rubric.rc: Close-up 3 and Still 4 show clear plough lines and bare soil texture across the tilled field.
rubric.mc: Close-ups 1–3 depict the field with oversized, smooth wave ridges rather than fine plough furrows in bare soil.

rubric.c: Greenhouse roofs read as bright sheeting or plastic film, clearly brighter than their surroundings, and the red roof reads as a matte painted roof
rubric.rc: Close-ups 1 and 2 show bright reflective greenhouse sheeting alongside a distinct matte red roof.
rubric.mc: In Close-ups 1–2, the structures read as flat untextured white and red boxes rather than bright plastic sheeting and painted roofing.

rubric.c: Nothing in the scene moves by itself that does not in the video: no invented swaying trees, drifting clouds or animated water
rubric.rc: Scene elements remain static relative to the ground with no invented foliage, water, or cloud animation.
rubric.mc: Nothing in the environment animates on its own during the capture.

rubric.c: When the clip ends it restarts cleanly from the first frame, with a single cut and no blank, black or half-drawn frame
rubric.rc: Technical notes confirm that after frame 464 the playback cuts cleanly back to the first frame.
rubric.mc: Per the technical notes, the procedural shader clip cuts cleanly back to the first frame at 18.5 s without blank frames.

rubric.c: No repeating texture tiles and no identical cloned trees are visible in the forest or fields
rubric.rc: Projected photographic imagery shows natural variation with no repeating tiles or cloned tree meshes.
rubric.mc: Procedural noise varies the canopy bumps across Stills 1–6 without image texture tiling or identical cloned tree meshes.

rubric.c: No clipping, floating pieces, stretched or smeared surfaces, including where tree outlines cross fields, roads and roofs
rubric.rc: Stretched and smeared surfaces appear along depth discontinuities where tree outlines cross the greenhouses, tilled soil, and pond in Close-ups 1, 3, and 4.
rubric.mc: Close-ups 1–4 exhibit severe vertical surface stretching along every tree-to-field drop-off and dashed ray-marching seam lines on flat ground.

rubric.c: A paused frame could pass for a frame of the video at first glance
rubric.rc: Side-by-side stills show that a paused frame easily passes for a video frame at first glance.
rubric.mc: Stills 1–6 immediately read as low-detail procedural heightmap renders and could not pass for video frames.

rubric.c: The camera flies straight forward over the forest toward the valley at a steady height, without turning, tilting or rolling
rubric.rc: The camera flies straight forward at a steady altitude and angle without unwanted turning or rolling.
rubric.mc: The camera translates straight forward at a steady pitch and roll throughout the 00:00–00:18 capture.

rubric.c: The move takes about 19 seconds at an even speed, with no sudden speed changes, stutter or shake that the video does not have
rubric.rc: Technical notes and the capture show a smooth 19.3-second advance with even speed.
rubric.mc: Per the technical notes and stepped capture, the camera advances smoothly at a constant rate over an 18.5 s duration.

rubric.c: The final view matches the video's last frame: greenhouse complex at the lower right, a corner of the tilled field at the bottom left, ridges unchanged across the background
rubric.rc: Still 6 matches the final video frame with the greenhouses lower right, tilled field bottom left, and unchanged background ridges.
rubric.mc: In Still 6, corrugated brown ground fills most of the foreground while a tall green wall blocks the lower right where the greenhouse complex belongs.

rubric.c: Ground revealed as the camera advances (the field behind the trees, the greenhouses behind the tree line) appears complete, with no holes, blank areas or stretched fill
rubric.rc: Between the 6-frame mesh updates, newly revealed ground behind foreground tree lines exhibits stretched rubber-sheet fill at occlusion edges.
rubric.mc: Newly revealed terrain in Stills 3–6 suffers from heavily stretched vertical walls and dashed ray-marching artifacts.

rubric.c: Nothing pops: objects do not jump, flicker, change shape or pulse in sharpness from frame to frame
rubric.rc: Stepping between the 78 discrete depth meshes every six frames produces subtle periodic popping and edge shifting along near treetops in the capture.
rubric.mc: From 00:04 to 00:11 in the capture and Close-ups 3–4, horizontal dashed artifact lines shimmer and shift across the lower-right ground.

rubric.c: The frame is complete to its edges for the whole clip: no unfinished borders, gaps or smeared edge pixels
rubric.rc: The rendered image fills the frame cleanly to all borders throughout the clip.
rubric.mc: The rendered image fills the viewport cleanly to all four edges throughout the capture.

rubric.c: Depth behaves as in the video: near treetops sweep past quickly, middle hills move slowly and the far ridges barely move
rubric.rc: Parallax matches the video, with near treetops sweeping past rapidly while mid-hills move slowly and far ridges stay nearly fixed.
rubric.mc: Parallax in the capture separates depth properly, with near canopy passing rapidly and distant ridges barely shifting.

rubric.c: Key reveals happen at the same moments as in the video: pond and track at the lower right by about 5 s, the tilled field opening up by about 10 s, the red-roofed building emerging from behind the trees at about 14 s, the whole greenhouse complex in view at the end
rubric.rc: The pond at 0:05, tilled field at 0:10, red roof at 0:14, and full greenhouse complex at 0:18–0:19 all appear on schedule.
rubric.mc: Reveal timing does not match: no pond appears at 5 s, the field is visible from the start, and the full greenhouse complex remains hidden behind a ridge at 18 s.

rubric.c: Paused at any moment, the page shows the same view as the video at that time, with objects in the same places in the frame
rubric.rc: All six comparison stills show scene features aligned in the exact same screen positions as the reference video.
rubric.mc: Side-by-side Stills 1–6 show major mismatches in terrain layout, object scale, and feature placement at every timestamp.
